blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Visual grounding in remote sensing images aims to locate objects described by referring expressions. Most existing methods predict horizontal bounding boxes, which are often inaccurate for objects with arbitrary orientations. To address this limitation, we introduce O 2 -VG, a family of models for oriented object visual grounding with three complementary designs.
Specifically, O 2 -VG-Trans is a cross-modality transformer for oriented object visual grounding. It establishes a strong discriminative foundation for the model family. Building upon it, O 2 -VG-Uni predicts universal oriented proposals for possible foreground objects without specific text prompts. It also supports object retrieval through cached proposal embeddings. Using these universal oriented proposals as input prompts, O 2 -VG-VLM is an autoregressive vision-language model. It generates oriented box token blocks in parallel through multi-token prediction.
In addition, we construct DIOR-R-RSVG, a dataset for oriented object visual grounding in remote sensing images. It provides image, expression, and oriented box triplets for training and evaluation. Together, the O 2 -VG family provides a flexible framework that spans discriminative transformers and generative vision-language models. It achieves superior performance across multiple benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/wokaikaixinxin/ai4rs .

具体来说,O 2-VG-Trans是一种面向对象视觉地面的跨模式变压器. 它为模范家庭奠定了牢固的歧视性基础。 在此基础上,O 2-VG-Uni预测,在没有具体文字提示的情况下,可能面向前景对象的普遍建议。 它还通过缓存建议嵌入支持对象检索. 使用这些通用导向的建议作为输入提示,O 2-VG-VLM是一种自旋式视觉语言模型. 它通过多键预测并行生成面向的箱形符号块.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Visual grounding, also known as referring expression comprehension [ 1 ] , aims to locate target objects in an image based on referring expressions.
It enables language-guided object localization by associating visual regions with textual descriptions.
Remote sensing images provide rich visual information of geographic scenes and support various applications [ 2 ] .
Compared with natural images [ 3 ] , remote sensing images contain objects with scale variations, dense distributions, and arbitrary orientations [ 4 ] .
Users often need to locate target objects through descriptions of their categories, attributes, or locations.
Therefore, visual grounding in remote sensing images has become an important task for connecting language descriptions with object localization.
blocks.zh:
视觉定位(Visual grounding),又称参考表达式理解[1],旨在基于参考表达式在图像中定位目标对象.
它通过将视觉区域与文字描述联系起来,使得语言引导对象本地化成为可能.
遥感图像提供了丰富的地理场景视觉信息,并支持各种应用[2].
与自然图像[3]相比,遥感图像包含具有尺度变化、分布密集和任意定向的物体 [4].
用户通常需要通过对其类别,属性或位置的描述来定位目标对象.
因此,在遥感图像中进行视觉定位已成为将语言描述与物体本地化联系起来的一项重要任务。

blocks.en: Most visual grounding methods return a horizontal bounding box (HBB) [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] . This representation leads to inaccurate localization with excessive background regions for oriented objects. Oriented bounding boxes (OBBs) provide a tighter representation by explicitly modeling the object center, size, and angle [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] , as illustrated in Fig. 1 . However, oriented object visual grounding requires the model to understand both the meaning of the expression and the geometric structure of the target. It also requires data that pairs language expressions with oriented annotations.
blocks.zh: 大多数视觉地面方法返回一个水平边框(HBB)[5,6,7]. 这种表述方式导致不准确的本地化,导致面向对象的背景区域过多. 定向边框(OBBs)通过对物体中心、大小和角度[8、9、10]明确建模,提供了更严格的表示,如图所示。 1 (英语). 然而,面向对象的视觉地面需要模型既了解表达的意义,又了解目标几何结构. 它还需要数据,将语言表达式与定向说明配对.

blocks.en: Existing remote sensing visual grounding (RSVG) methods mainly use discriminative architectures [ 7 ] . They match text features with image regions and then regress a box. These methods usually depend on horizontal proposals and task specific heads. Generative vision language models offer a more flexible interface [ 11 , 12 ] . Both visual and text inputs are modeled under the next-token prediction paradigm. Their autoregressive decoding, however, produces coordinate tokens one at a time. This can be slow when an image contains many targets. It may also produce invalid box structures. These limitations motivate a unified study of oriented object visual grounding.
blocks.zh: 现有的遥感视觉地面测量方法主要使用歧视性建筑[7]. 它们将文本特性与图像区域匹配,然后递归一个框。 这些方法通常取决于横向建议和任务特定负责人. 基因视觉语言模型提供了一个更灵活的界面[11,12]. 视觉输入和文字输入均在下一个托肯预测范式下进行模型化. 然而,它们的自动回转解码一次产生一个坐标符。 当一个图像包含许多目标时,这可能很慢. 它也可能产生无效的框结构. 这些限制促使对面向对象的视觉地面进行统一研究.

blocks.en:
In this work, we present O 2 -VG, a model family for oriented object visual grounding in remote sensing images, as illustrated in Fig. 2 . Specifically, we first build O 2 -VG-Trans, a strong discriminative end-to-end cross-modality transformer, which serves as the foundation of the O 2 -VG family. Building upon it, O 2 -VG-Uni produces universal oriented proposals for possible foreground objects without specific text prompts and supports object retrieval with proposal embeddings. O 2 -VG-VLM is an autoregressive vision-language model that uses these universal proposals as text prompts. It predicts oriented box tokens in parallel within each block while maintaining a causal order between blocks. A hybrid inference strategy further combines parallel decoding with token-by-token decoding when invalid blocks are generated. To facilitate oriented object visual grounding, we construct a new dataset, DIOR-R-RSVG. It contains image, expression, and oriented box triplets for training and evaluation.
We evaluate the proposed models and dataset on multiple benchmarks to validate their effectiveness for oriented object visual grounding in remote sensing images.

O 2-VG-VLM是一种自旋式视觉语言模型,使用这些通用提案作为文本提示. 它在每一块内平行地预测方向的箱形符号,同时保持区块之间的因果顺序. 混合推导策略在生成无效块时,进一步将并行解码与按键解码结合. 为了方便面向对象的视觉定位,我们构建了一个新的数据集DIOR-R-RSVG. 它包含图像、表达和面向的三进制框,用于培训和评估。
我们评价拟议模型和数据集的多种基准,以验证其在遥感图像中面向物体的视觉定位方面的有效性。

blocks.en: The contributions of this paper are summarized as follows. • We propose O 2 -VG-Trans, a discriminative cross-modality transformer framework for oriented object visual grounding, which establishes a strong foundation for the O 2 -VG family. • We design O 2 -VG-Uni, a universal oriented proposal framework that provides potential foreground proposals without specific text prompts and supports object retrieval through proposal embeddings. • We develop O 2 -VG-VLM, an autoregressive vision-language grounding model that generates oriented box tokens through multi-token prediction within a unified generation framework. • We introduce DIOR-R-RSVG, a new oriented object visual grounding dataset containing remote sensing image, referring expression, and oriented box triplets for training and evaluation.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Discriminative Remote Sensing Visual Grounding
blocks.zh: II-A 歧视性遥感视觉定位

blocks.en: Remote sensing visual grounding aims to localize the object referred to by an expression. Existing discriminative methods can be broadly grouped into graph-based, CNN-based, and Transformer-based approaches according to their paradigm.
blocks.zh: 遥感视觉地面定位旨在将一种表达所指的物体定位。 现有的歧视性方法可根据其范式广泛分为图表法、CNN法和变形器法。

blocks.en: Graph-based methods construct geospatial relations among candidate regions to reduce the search space in large-scale scenes. GeoVG [ 6 ] represents referring expressions as relation graphs and matches them with image regions. CNN-based methods adopt two-stage or one-stage designs. Two-stage methods use CNN-extracted proposals and select the region with the highest visual-text matching score [ 13 ] , so performance depends on proposal recall and incurs matching cost. One-stage methods inject language features into CNN maps and directly regress horizontal boxes from dense locations [ 14 ] . Transformer-based methods use self-attention and cross-attention to capture long-range dependencies between image regions and language tokens. By jointly modeling global context and fine-grained visual-text interactions, they improve grounding robustness in cluttered scenes and under complex referring expressions [ 5 , 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 基于图表的方法构建了候选区域之间的地理空间关系,以减少大型场景中的搜索空间. GeoVG [6] 代表将表达式称为关系图,并与图像区域匹配. 基于CNN的方法采用两个阶段或一个阶段的设计. 两阶段方法使用CNN提取的建议,并选择视觉文本匹配分数最高的区域[13],因此性能取决于提案召回,并产生匹配成本. 单阶段方法在CNN地图中注入语言特征,并从密集地点直接递归水平框[14]. 基于变形器的方法使用自感和跨感来捕捉图像区域与语言符号之间的长距离依赖. 通过共同模拟全球背景和精细的视觉文字互动,它们提高了在复杂场景和复杂参考表达方式[5,7]中的基础强度。

blocks.en: Existing discriminative remote sensing visual grounding methods focus on horizontal boxes, which cannot accurately describe objects with arbitrary orientations. Unlike existing methods, our approach performs oriented object visual grounding, enabling more accurate localization of arbitrarily rotated targets.
blocks.zh: 现有的歧视性遥感视觉定位方法侧重于水平箱,无法准确描述具有任意定向的物体. 与现有方法不同的是,我们的方法进行面向对象的视觉定位,使得任意旋转的目标能够更精确地本地化.

blocks.en: II-B Generative VLM for Remote Sensing Visual Grounding
blocks.zh: II-B 遥感视地定位基因VLM

blocks.en: Generative autoregressive vision-language models unify visual grounding and textual generation within a single next-token prediction framework.
blocks.zh: 基因自递式视觉语言模型将视觉地基和文字生成统一在一个单一的近亲预测框架内.

blocks.en: Among existing generative RSVG methods with oriented-box outputs, GeoChat [ 11 ] follows the LLaVA-v1.5 [ 15 ] architecture, coupling a CLIP-ViT [ 16 ] visual encoder with a two-layer MLP adaptor and a Vicuna language decoder. It pioneers instruction-following grounding by treating object localization and orientation prediction as text generation, while also supporting diverse remote sensing vision-language tasks. GeoGround [ 12 ] similarly adopts a CLIP-ViT visual encoder, a two-layer MLP connector, and a Vicuna decoder. It provides a unified framework for HBB, OBB, and mask grounding, using a Text-Mask representation to support flexible output formats within a single VLM.
blocks.zh: 在现有具有定向框输出的基因RSVG方法中,GeoChat [11]遵循LLaVA-v1.5 [15]架构,将一个CLIP-ViT [16] 视觉编码器与一个双层的MLP适配器和一个维库纳语言解码器结合. 它首先通过将物体定位和定向预测作为文本生成处理,同时支持各种遥感视觉语言任务,从而开创了遵循指示的地面。 GeoGround [12] 同样采用了CLIP-ViT视觉编码器,双层MLP连接器,以及维库纳解码器. 它为六溴代二苯、二溴代二苯和遮罩地面提供了统一框架,使用文本-掩体表示支持单一VLM内的灵活输出格式。

blocks.en: Unlike these methods, our vlm adopts multi-token prediction to generate the complete token block of each oriented box in parallel while preserving causal dependencies across blocks.
blocks.zh: 与这些方法不同的是,我们的vlm采用多键预测,以生成每个方向框的完整符号块平行,同时保留各块之间的因果关系.

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we present the family of models for oriented object visual grounding in remote sensing imagery. O 2 -VG-Trans (Sec. III-A ) serves as the foundational framework, a cross-modality transformer. Building upon it, O 2 -VG-Uni (Sec. III-B ) removes the reliance on text prompts, evolving into a universal oriented proposal generator that supports fast retrieval. O 2 -VG-VLM (Sec. III-C ) leverages the oriented proposals as part of the input prompts to an autoregressive vision-language model with multi-token coordinate prediction.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍了遥感图像中面向物体的视觉定位模型。 O 2-VG-Trans(Sec. III-A)作为基础框架,是跨模式变压器. 在此基础上,O 2-VG-Uni(Sec. III-B)取消了对文本提示的依赖,逐渐发展成为支持快速检索的面向通用的建议书生成器. O 2-VG-VLM(Sec. III-C)将面向方向的提议作为输入提示的一部分,用于一个带有多键坐标预测的自旋式视觉语言模型.

blocks.en: III-B O 2 -VG-Uni: A Universal Oriented Proposal Generator
blocks.zh: III-B O 2-VG-Uni:通用定向提议生成器

blocks.en: Building upon the foundation of O 2 -VG-Trans, we introduce O 2 -VG-Uni, a universal oriented proposal generator without the need for special text prompts, as illustrated in Fig. 4 . This design enables two capabilities: (1) extracting universal oriented objects without specific text information, and (2) supporting fast object retrieval through cached proposal embeddings.
blocks.zh: 在O 2-VG-Trans的基础上,我们引入O 2-VG-Uni,这是一个通用的面向建议生成器,不需要特殊的文本提示,如Fig所示. 4 (英语). 这种设计可以实现两种能力:(1)在没有特定文本信息的情况下提取通用面向对象,(2)通过缓存建议嵌入支持快速对象检索.

blocks.en: Two-Stage Training Recipe. In the first stage, only the pretrained text encoder is frozen while the entire visual branch is trained, aligning vision and language through contrastive learning. In the second stage, we freeze the entire visual branch with weights inherited from the first stage, and replace the text encoder with the learnable objectness prompt 𝑬 o ​ b ​ j \bm{E}_{obj} to extract objects of arbitrary categories.
blocks.zh: 双阶训练补习. 在第一阶段,只有预先训练的文本编码器被冻结,而整个视觉分支则经过训练,通过对比学习来调整视觉和语言. 在第二阶段,我们用从第一阶段继承下来的权重冻结整个视觉分支,并将文本编码器替换为可学习对象提示 E o b j\bm{E}_{obj},以提取任意类对象.

blocks.en: Image Backbone. Given an input RGB image 𝑰 ∈ ℝ 3 × H × W \bm{I}\in\mathbb{R}^{3\times H\times W} , we adopt ResNetvd [ 22 ] as the image backbone to extract three feature maps. A convolutional Channel Mapper then projects these features into a uniform 256-dimensional space, producing { 𝑷 i } i = 3 5 \{\bm{P}_{i}\}_{i=3}^{5} , where 𝑷 i ∈ ℝ 256 × H i × W i \bm{P}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{256\times H_{i}\times W_{i}} corresponds to strides of { 8 , 16 , 32 } \{8,16,32\} , respectively. This design employs one fewer feature layer than O 2 -VG-Trans.
blocks.zh: 图像背骨. 考虑到输入的 RGB 图像 I QQ R 3 × H × W\bm{I}\in\mathbb{R}^{3\times H\times W},我们采用 ResNetvd [22] 作为图像主干线来提取三个特征地图. 演化通道映射器然后将这些特性投射到一个256维的统一空间中,生成 {Pi}i = 3 5 {bm{P}_{i}\}_{i=i=3}^{5},其中 Pi → R 256 × H i → W\bm{P}_{i}\in\mathb{R}^{256\times 时间 W_{i}}对应的步数分别为{8,16,32}\{8,16,32\}. 这个设计使用的特性层比O 2 - VG - Trans少一个.

blocks.en: Text Encoder. Given a set of N c N_{c} category names, we employ a frozen pretrained RemoteCLIP [ 23 ] text encoder to produce category-level semantic embeddings. The encoder processes each prompt as an independent input sequence and outputs a text embedding matrix 𝑪 ∈ ℝ N c × 512 \bm{C}\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{c}\times 512} , where each row corresponds to one category.
blocks.zh: 文本编码器. 鉴于一组N c NQQC} 类别名称, 我们使用一个已冻结的预选远程CLIP [23] 文本编码器来生成类别级语义嵌入. 编码器作为独立的输入序列处理每个编码器,输出一个文本嵌入矩阵 C QQ R N c × 512\bm{C}\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{c}\times 512},其中每行对应一个类别.

blocks.en: Hybrid Encoder. Following the hybrid encoder paradigm from [ 19 ] , the encoder decouples intra-scale interactions and cross-scale fusion. A self-attention block is applied to the top-level feature map 𝑷 5 \bm{P}_{5} , while a CNN module enables efficient fusion of multi-scale features, producing enhanced visual features 𝑽 ∈ ℝ N v × 256 \bm{V}\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{v}\times 256} . Different from the cross-modality encoder in O 2 -VG-Trans, it operates only on image features.
blocks.zh: 混合编码器. 遵循[19]的混合编码器范式,编码器脱钩在尺度内相互作用和跨尺度聚变. 对顶层特征图P 5\bm{P}_{5}应用了自注意块,而有线电视新闻网的模块则能够高效地整合多级特征,生成增强的视觉特征V ∈R N v × 256\bm{V}\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{v}\Times 256}. 不同于O 2-VG-Trans中的跨模式编码器,它只在图像特性上运行.

blocks.en: Learnable Objectness Prompt. To obtain universal oriented proposals, we introduce a learnable objectness prompt 𝑬 o ​ b ​ j ∈ ℝ 1 × 512 \bm{E}_{obj}\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times 512} . This embedding 𝑬 o ​ b ​ j \bm{E}_{obj} represents only objectness, indicating whether a region contains a foreground object.
blocks.zh: 可学习对象提示 。 为了获得普遍导向的建议, 我们引入一个可学习对象性 提示 E o b j Q → R 1 × 512\bm{ E}_{obj}\in\ mathbb{ R}^{1\times [512]. 此嵌入 E o b j\bm{ E}_{obj} 只代表对象, 表示一个区域是否包含一个前景对象 。

blocks.en:
Query Selection. To unify dimensions, the visual features 𝑽 \bm{V} are first projected by a weight matrix to obtain visual embeddings 𝑿 V ∈ ℝ N v × 512 \bm{X}_{V}\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{v}\times 512} . We then compute a similarity matrix 𝑴 \bm{M} between 𝑿 V \bm{X}_{V} and the guiding embeddings as: 𝑴 = { 𝑿 V ⋅ 𝑪 ⊤ ‖ 𝑿 V ‖ 2 ​ ‖ 𝑪 ‖ 2 ⊤ ∈ ℝ N v × N c , stage 1 , 𝑿 V ⋅ 𝑬 ⊤ ‖ 𝑿 V ‖ 2 ​ ‖ 𝑬 ‖ 2 ⊤ ∈ ℝ N v × 1 , stage 2 . \bm{M}=\begin{cases}\dfrac{\bm{X}_{V}\cdot\bm{C}^{\top}}{\|\bm{X}_{V}\|_{2}\|\bm{C}\|_{2}^{\top}}\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{v}\times N_{c}},&\text{stage 1},\\[8.0pt]
\dfrac{\bm{X}_{V}\cdot\bm{E}^{\top}}{\|\bm{X}_{V}\|_{2}\|\bm{E}\|_{2}^{\top}}\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{v}\times 1},&\text{stage 2}.\end{cases} (6) By taking the maximum value along the text dimension of 𝑴 \bm{M} , we select the top- K K candidates to form the oriented reference boxes 𝑩 ∈ ℝ K × 5 \bm{B}\in\mathbb{R}^{K\times 5} and query embeddings 𝑸 ∈ ℝ K × 256 \bm{Q}\in\mathbb{R}^{K\times 256} , which are then fed into the decoder, where K K is set to 300 by default.

Image decoder. Following the decoder paradigm from [ 19 ] , the image decoder consists of multiple stacked decoder layers, each containing self-attention, cross-attention, and feed-forward networks. Different from the cross-modality decoder in O 2 -VG-Trans, it operates only on image modality.
blocks.zh: 影像解码器. 遵循[19]的解码器范式,图像解码器由多个堆叠的解码器层组成,每个层包含自觉性,跨自觉性,以及向导网络. 不同于O 2-VG-Trans中的跨模式解码器,它只在图像模式上运行.

blocks.en: Head and Loss. The prediction head consists of a contrastive classification branch and a regression branch. For classification, the updated queries 𝑸 \bm{Q} are first projected using a weight matrix to obtain proposal embeddings 𝑬 Q ∈ ℝ K × 512 \bm{E}_{Q}\in\mathbb{R}^{K\times 512} . In training stage 1, cosine similarity scores between the proposal embeddings 𝑬 Q \bm{E}_{Q} and text embeddings 𝑪 \bm{C} are computed following Eq. 3 , while in training stage 2, cosine similarity scores between the proposal embeddings 𝑬 Q \bm{E}_{Q} and objectness embeddings 𝑬 o ​ b ​ j \bm{E}_{obj} are computed similarly. For regression, a Multi-Layer Perceptron predicts oriented boxes. The loss settings are similar to those of O 2 -VG-Trans.
blocks.zh: 头和损失。 预测头由对比分类分支和一个回归分支组成. 对于分类,更新的查询Q\bm{Q}首先使用权重矩阵进行预测,以获得嵌入E Q\}R K × 512\bm{E\in\mathbb{R\K\times的建议书. [512]. 在培训阶段1, 嵌入 E Q\bm{E} 和文本嵌入 C\bm{C} 的同位素相似性分数在 Eq. 3 之后计算,而在培训阶段2, 嵌入 E Q\bm{E} 和 嵌入 E o b j\bm{E}_{obj} 的同位素相似性分数在计算中类似。 对于回归,一个多Layer Perceptron预测方向箱. 损失设置与O 2-VG-Trans类似.

blocks.en: Object Retrieval. Unlike other class-agnostic proposal networks [ 24 ] , our proposal embeddings retain semantic information and can therefore be used for object retrieval. The oriented proposal embeddings 𝑬 Q \bm{E}_{Q} can be cached, while the text embeddings generated by RemoteCLIP are used as retrieval queries. We compute the cosine similarity between the cached proposal embeddings and the text embeddings to realize object retrieval.
blocks.zh: 对象检索 。 与其他类不可知建议网络[24]不同,我们的建议嵌入保留语义信息,因此可用于对象检索. 面向的建议嵌入E Q\bm{E}可以缓存,而由远程CLIP生成的文本嵌入则用作检索查询. 我们计算缓存建议嵌入和文本嵌入之间的余弦相似性以实现对象检索.

blocks.en: III-C O 2 -VG-VLM: Vision-Language Grounding with Multi-Token Prediction
blocks.zh: III-C O 2-VG-VLM: 视野-语言定位与多托肯预测

blocks.en: O 2 -VG-VLM is built upon an autoregressive vision-language model [ 25 ] pre-trained on large-scale image-text corpora. The architecture consists of three main components: a Moon-ViT vision encoder [ 26 ] , an MLP projector, and a Qwen2.5 language decoder [ 27 ] , as shown in Fig. 5 .
blocks.zh: O 2-VG-VLM基于一个自旋式视觉语言模型[25]在大规模图像文本蝎子上进行预训. 建筑由三个主要部分组成:月球-ViT视觉编码器[26],MLP投影仪,以及Qwen2.5语言解码器[27],如图5所示.

blocks.en: Vision Encoder. The Moon-ViT vision encoder splits the input image 𝑰 ∈ ℝ 3 × H × W \bm{I}\in\mathbb{R}^{3\times H\times W} into 14 × 14 14\times 14 patches and encodes them with a 27-layer Transformer with 16 attention heads and hidden dimension 1152 1152 . The resulting visual features are then merged with a 2 × 2 2\times 2 kernel to reduce the visual token length, yielding 𝒁 I ∈ ℝ N v × 1152 \bm{Z}_{I}\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{v}\times 1152} before being fed into the projector.
blocks.zh: 视觉编码器. 月球- ViT 视觉编码器将输入图像 I QQ R 3 × H × W\bm{I}\in\ mathbb{R}^{3\times H\times W} 进入 14 × 14 14\time 14 补丁,并用 27 层的变形器编码它们,上面有 16 个注意头和 隐藏的尺寸 1152 1152 . 由此产生的视觉功能随后与2×2 2\times 2内核合并,以减少视觉符号长度,产生Z I → R N v 1152\bm{Z}_{I}\in\mathb{R}^{N_{v}\times 1152},然后输入投影机.

blocks.en: Projector. The visual tokens produced by MoonViT are first adapted to the language decoder through a lightweight MLP projector f proj f_{\mathrm{proj}} . This projector consists of two MLP connector layers and maps MoonViT features from the 1152-dimensional vision space to the 2048-dimensional hidden space of Qwen2.5, giving 𝒁 V = f proj ​ ( 𝒁 I ) ∈ ℝ N v × 2048 \bm{Z}_{V}=f_{\mathrm{proj}}(\bm{Z}_{I})\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{v}\times 2048} .
blocks.zh: 投影仪 MoonViT制作的视觉符号首先通过轻量级的MLP投影器f proj f_{\ mathrm{proj}}]来适应语言解码器. 这个投影机由两个MLP连接层组成,并映射了月球ViT从1152维视空间到2048维视隐藏空间的Quen2.5的特征,给出了Z V = f proj (Z I) ∈ R N v × 2048\bm{Z V}=f_{\ _{\ mathrm{ proj}} (\bm{ZI})\in\ mathbb{ R}^{N_{v}\ }\ Times [2048].

blocks.en: Language Decoder. The Qwen2.5 language decoder serves as the generative core of the model. It has a hidden size of 2048, 36 transformer layers, and 16 attention heads. It receives the projected visual embeddings 𝒁 V \bm{Z}_{V} together with the text embeddings 𝒁 T \bm{Z}_{T} .
blocks.zh: 语言解码器. Quen2.5语言解码器作为模型的基因核心. 它的藏式尺寸为2048,36个变压器层,16个注意力头. 它接收了预测的视觉嵌入Z V\bm{Z}_{V}以及文本嵌入Z T\bm{Z}_{T}.

blocks.en: Convert Oriented Boxes to Tokens. To align continuous box coordinates with the discrete token-based output space, each component of ( c ​ x , c ​ y , w , h , θ ) (cx,cy,w,h,\theta) is discretized into 1000 bins within [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] . Specifically, ( c ​ x , w ) (cx,w) and ( c ​ y , h ) (cy,h) are scaled by the image width W W and height H H , respectively, while the angle θ \theta is scaled by its predefined range. For instance, the discrete center coordinate is computed as ( round ⁡ ( 1000 × c ​ x / W ) , round ⁡ ( 1000 × c ​ y / H ) ) (\mathrm{round}(1000\times cx/W),\mathrm{round}(1000\times cy/H)) .

blocks.en: Next-Token Prediction. Let the answer sequence generated by the next-token prediction (NTP) be denoted as x 1 : N ntp x_{1:N_{\text{ntp}}} . The NTP objective maximizes the conditional likelihood of each token given all preceding tokens: ℒ NTP = − ∑ n = 1 N ntp log P ( x n + 1 ∣ x 1 : n , 𝒁 V , 𝒁 T ) , \mathcal{L}_{\text{NTP}}=-\sum_{n=1}^{N_{\text{ntp}}}\log P(x_{n+1}\mid x_{1:n},\bm{Z}_{V},\bm{Z}_{T}), (7) where the sum ranges over every answer position.

NTP目标将每个令牌的附加条件概率最大化,并给出了所有前几个令牌: LNTP = - ∑ n = 1 Nnntp log P (x n + 1 ∣ x 1 : n, Z V, Z T),\ mathcal{ L}_{\ text{ NTP}}=-\ sum_{n = 1}^{ n_{\ text{ ntp}}}\log P( x_{n+1}\) mid x_{1:n},\bm{Z}_{V},\bm{Z}_{T}, (7) 在总和与每个答复位置之间。

blocks.en: Causal Attention for NTP. For next-token prediction, O 2 -VG-VLM employs a causal attention mechanism, which ensures that each token can only attend to prior tokens. By masking future positions, the attention preserves the left-to-right order of the generated sequence, making it naturally suited for language decoding tasks.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2019-03-09). Causal Record for NTP. 对于下切的预测,O 2-VG-VLM采用了一种因果注意机制,确保每个令牌只能处理以前的令牌. 通过掩盖未来的位置,注意力保留了生成序列的左对右顺序,使其自然适合语言解码任务.

blocks.en:
Multi-Token Prediction. Each block has a fixed length of seven tokens. A Referring Expression Block encodes the referring expression. When the expression length exceeds the block length, it is split into consecutive blocks. An Oriented Box Block comprises five tokens representing the oriented bounding box ( c ​ x , c ​ y , w , h , θ ) (cx,cy,w,h,\theta) and two special tokens, e.g., <box> and </box> . An End Block signals the termination of generation. Any unused positions within a block are padded with a <null> token.

blocks.en: Bidirectional Intra-Block Attention. Within each MTP block, we employ bidirectional attention, allowing all seven positions to attend to one another. This design enables the model to jointly capture the structural dependencies among tokens within a block, such as the dependencies between the coordinate tokens and boundary tokens of an oriented box, and to predict the entire block simultaneously.
blocks.zh: 双向内锁注意。 在中期计划的每个组成部分中,我们采用双向注意,使所有七个职位能够相互照顾。 这种设计使模型能够联合捕捉一个块内符符之间的结构依赖性,例如一个方向箱的坐标符与边界符之间的依赖性,并同时预测整个块.

blocks.en: Causal Flow Across Blocks. Across MTP blocks, attention follows a causal order. The current block can attend to the visual-textual context and all previously committed tokens, but not to tokens in subsequent blocks. This block-causal design preserves the sequential dependency between different referring-expression, box, and end blocks, while retaining parallel prediction within each block.
blocks.zh: 横冲直撞 在整个中期计划块中,注意遵循一个因果顺序。 目前的块可以关注视觉文字上下文和所有先前承诺的符号,但不能关注后续块中的符号. 这种区块-causal设计保留了不同引用表达式,框和端块之间的顺序依赖,同时保留了每个区块内的平行预测.

blocks.en: Inference Modes. O 2 -VG-VLM supports three inference modes. Slow Mode uses standard NTP to generate tokens autoregressively, providing the most reliable decoding. Fast Mode uses MTP to generate seven-token blocks in parallel for maximum throughput. Hybrid Mode performs MTP by default and validates each generated block. When an invalid box structure is detected, the current block is discarded and the model switches to NTP to decode the problematic box token by token. Specifically, an invalid coordinate is identified when the top-1 coordinate token’s probability is below 0.9 and the span of the valid top-5 coordinate tokens exceeds 60 within the [0, 1000] normalized space. After the box is completed, decoding resumes in MTP mode. This design combines the efficiency of parallel block decoding with the robustness of autoregressive generation.
blocks.zh: 推论模式. O2-VG-VLM支持三种推论模式. Slow Mode使用标准的NTP自动生成令牌,提供最可靠的解码. Fast Mode为了最大吞吐量,使用MTP并行生成七键块. Hybrid Mode默认执行MTP,并验证每个生成的块. 当检测到一个无效的框结构时,会丢弃当前块,模型切换到NTP,以以符号解码有问题的框符号. 具体地说,当顶-1坐标符的概率低于0.9,且有效顶-5坐标符的跨度在[0,1000]正态空间内超过60时,就会发现一个无效坐标. 盒完成后,恢复MTP模式的解码. 这种设计结合了平行块解码的效率与自动递归生成的稳健性.

pipeline using PyTorch. The entire model is fine-tuned with BF16 mixed
precision. The per-device batch size is set to 1 with 16 gradient
accumulation steps. We use AdamW

Gradient checkpointing is enabled, and the maximum sequence length is

blocks.en: V-D O 2 -VG-Trans Results for Visual Grounding
blocks.zh: V-D O 2-VG- 视觉地面转换结果

blocks.en: Since no small-parameter method has been specifically designed for the oriented object visual grounding task, we adapt three horizontal object visual grounding methods by incorporating angle prediction.
blocks.zh: 由于没有专门为面向对象的视觉定位任务设计过小参数法,我们通过纳入角度预测来调整三种水平对象的视觉定位方法.

blocks.en:
GiT [ 32 ] is a vision transformer that unifies diverse vision tasks into an autoregressive framework built on the SAM ViT. Rotated GiT-B further introduces an angle token to support oriented object prediction.
Grounding DINO [ 34 ] is a grounded pre-training Transformer. Rotated GDINO further appends an angle prediction branch using CSL [ 35 ] .
Efficient Grounding DINO [ 7 ] improves Grounding DINO for horizontal visual grounding in remote sensing images. Rotated EGDINO further appends an angle prediction branch using CSL [ 35 ] .
blocks.zh:
GiT [32]是一个将多样化的视觉任务统一成基于SAM VIT的自旋框架的视觉变换器. Roomed GiT-B进一步引入了一个角度符,支持面向对象的预测.
地面DINO[34]是一个被禁的训练前变形器. 旋转的 GDINO 进一步附加了使用 CSL [35] 的角度预测分支 。
高效地基DINO[7]改进 将DINO用于遥感图像中的横向视觉地面。 旋转的 EGDINO 进一步附加了使用 CSL [35] 的角预测分支 。

blocks.en: Table II compares O 2 -VG-Trans with other methods on VRSBench, AVVG, and DIOR-R-RSVG. O 2 -VG-Trans consistently outperforms Rotated GiT, Rotated GDINO, and Rotated EGDINO across all three datasets and evaluation metrics. On VRSBench, it achieves 67.71% Pr@0.5, 55.01% meanIoU, and 61.14% cumIoU. On AVVG, O 2 -VG-Trans obtains 18.00% Pr@0.5, 14.59% meanIoU, and 16.64% cumIoU. On DIOR-R-RSVG, it further achieves 67.23% Pr@0.5, 56.73% meanIoU, and 67.33% cumIoU. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of O 2 -VG-Trans for oriented visual grounding in remote sensing images.

blocks.zh: V-E O 2-VG-Uni 通用定向提案结果

blocks.en: Since there are no existing universal proposal methods specifically designed for oriented objects, we adapt the widely used horizontal object proposal method RPN [ 24 ] to generate oriented proposals following the design of Oriented R-CNN [ 36 ] .
blocks.zh: 由于不存在专门为定向对象设计的现有的通用建议方法,我们调整了广泛使用的横向目标建议方法RPN[24],以在定向R-CNN[36]设计后产生定向建议.

blocks.en:
Table III presents the universal oriented proposal results with 100 and 300 proposals. Overall, O 2 -VG-Uni achieves superior performance on VRSBench, AVVG, and DIOR-R-RSVG. In particular, with only 100 proposals, O 2 -VG-Uni achieves AR 50:95 scores of 55.48, 73.61, and 59.76 on VRSBench, AVVG, and DIOR-R-RSVG, respectively.
When increasing the number of proposals to 300, O 2 -VG-Uni further improves its recall across all datasets, achieving AR 50:95 scores of 56.41, 75.36, and 60.78, respectively.

blocks.en: Notably, O 2 -VG-Uni adopts a real-time end-to-end Transformer architecture and runs at 83 FPS, faster than the Rotated RPN variants.

blocks.en: V-F O 2 -VG-VLM Results for Visual Grounding
blocks.zh: V-F O 2-VG-VLM 视觉定位结果

blocks.en: We compare O 2 -VG-VLM with GeoChat and GeoGround, two representative LLaVA-based methods [ 15 ] that support oriented object visual grounding in remote sensing images. Both methods are fine-tuned following their official guidelines. As shown in Table IV , O 2 -VG-VLM consistently outperforms GeoChat and GeoGround across all three datasets and evaluation metrics, despite having fewer parameters. On VRSBench, it achieves 69.67% Pr@0.5, 59.84% meanIoU, and 59.36% cumIoU. On AVVG, O 2 -VG-VLM obtains 31.29% Pr@0.5, 26.44% meanIoU, and 27.52% cumIoU. On DIOR-R-RSVG, it further achieves 78.35% Pr@0.5, 67.85% meanIoU, and 74.66% cumIoU. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of O 2 -VG-VLM for oriented visual grounding in remote sensing images.
blocks.zh: 我们把O 2-VG-VLM与GeoChat和GeoGround进行比较,这两种具有代表性的LLAVA方法[15]支持遥感图像中面向物体的视觉定位。 这两种方法都按照官方准则进行了微调。 如表四所示,O 2-VG-VLM在所有三个数据集和评价度量表上的业绩始终高于GeoChat和GeoGround,尽管参数较少。 在VRS Bench上,它实现了69.67%的Pr@0.5,59.84%的IoU和59.36%的cumIoU. 在AVVG上,O2-VG-VLM获得31.29%的Pr@0.5,26.44%的IoU和27.52%的cumIoU. 在DOOR-R-RSVG方面,它还实现了78.35%的Pr@0.5、67.85%的IoU和74.66%的CumIoU。 这些结果表明O2-VG-VLM在遥感图像中面向视觉地面的效能。

The precision, recall, and F1 scores are first computed within each class and then averaged across different classes. The threshold for CLIP and RemoteCLIP is based on cosine similarity, whereas that for O 2 -VG-Uni is based on the prediction score.

blocks.en: Overall, O 2 -VG-Uni demonstrates strong object retrieval capability across the three datasets. Specifically, it achieves F1 scores of 56.86%, 3.65%, and 49.25% on VRSBench, AVVG, and DIOR-R-RSVG, respectively. Its recall reaches 53.11%, 2.45%, and 55.26% on the three datasets, respectively.

O 2 -VG-VLM Ablation Study. Table VIII presents the ablation study of different components in O 2 -VG-VLM on the DIOR-R-RSVG dataset.
① When the oriented box is directly tokenized as text, the performance drops significantly.
This is because continuous coordinate values may be split into multiple tokens by the tokenizer, which disrupts the spatial structure.
② Replacing the ( c ​ x , c ​ y , w , h , θ ) (cx,cy,w,h,\theta) representation with four vertex coordinates also causes a large performance degradation. This is mainly because the vertex-based representation requires predicting longer coordinate sequences (from 5 to 8 tokens) and is sensitive to vertex ordering, which may result in irregular quadrilateral outputs.
③ Removing universal oriented proposals reduces the meanIoU from 67.85% to 61.90%, showing that universal oriented proposals provide more accurate spatial priors.
Using only NTP (④) or MTP (⑤) limits the model’s performance, indicating that the combination of NTP and MTP provides complementary supervision and enhances the oriented visual grounding capability.

blocks.en: O 2 -VG-VLM Different Inference Modes. Table IX compares the three inference modes of O 2 -VG-VLM. The slow mode achieves the best performance on all three datasets due to reliable autoregressive decoding. The fast mode improves decoding efficiency but slightly reduces localization accuracy. The hybrid mode balances localization performance and inference efficiency. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed hybrid strategy.
blocks.zh: O 2- VG- VLM 不同推论模式. 表九比较了O 2-VG-VLM的三种推论模式. 由于可靠自递解码,慢模式在所有三个数据集上都实现了最佳性能. 快模式提高了解码效率,但略微降低了本地化精度. 混合模式平衡了本地化性能和推论效率. 这些结果表明拟议混合战略的有效性。

blocks.en: Universal Oriented Proposals for O 2 -VG-VLM. Table X evaluates the effect of universal oriented proposals on O 2 -VG-VLM. Introducing universal oriented proposals consistently improves localization performance across all three datasets. In particular, the improvements become more significant under higher IoU thresholds, indicating that the proposed proposals provide more accurate oriented object localization. For example, on DIOR-R-RSVG, the meanIoU improves from 61.90 to 67.85, while the cumIoU increases from 69.33 to 74.66. These results demonstrate that universal oriented proposals effectively enhance the grounding capability of O 2 -VG-VLM.

blocks.en: Additionally, Fig. 9 presents the training loss curves of O 2 -VG-VLM on the VRSBench, AVVG, and DIOR-R-RSVG datasets with and without universal oriented proposals. With universal oriented proposals, the training loss converges faster and achieves a more stable optimization process, demonstrating that high-quality oriented proposals facilitate more effective visual grounding learning.

blocks.en: Overall O 2 -VG Family. Fig. 10 provides an overview of the O 2 -VG family on VRSBench. The figure presents the complete pipeline from referring expressions to oriented object localization. O 2 -VG-Trans, as a discriminative Transformer-based model, directly predicts the oriented grounding box. O 2 -VG-Uni extends O 2 -VG-Trans to generate universal oriented proposals for potential foreground objects. These universal proposals are further incorporated into the input prompts of O 2 -VG-VLM for vision-language visual grounding. The examples illustrate the different roles of the three models within the unified O 2 -VG framework.
blocks.zh: 总体O2-VG家庭. 图10概述了VRS Bench上的O 2-VG家族. 图中列出了从将表达式参考到面向对象本地化的完整管道. O 2-VG-Trans,作为带有歧视性的变形器基模型,直接预测方向的地面箱. O 2-VG-Uni扩展O 2-VG-Trans,为潜在前景对象生成普遍导向的建议. 这些通用建议被进一步纳入O2-VG-VLM的输入提示中,用于视觉语言视觉定位。 例子说明了三个模型在统一的O2-VG框架内的不同作用.

blocks.en: O 2 -VG-Trans for Oriented Object Visual Grounding. Figs. 11 shows qualitative results of O 2 -VG-Trans on DIOR-R-RSVG and AVVG. The predicted oriented boxes closely follow the target objects under different object scales, orientations, and spatial distributions. The results also show that O 2 -VG-Trans can capture detailed information in referring expressions, such as color attributes and relative positions.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose the O 2 -VG family for oriented object visual grounding in remote sensing images. O 2 -VG-Trans introduces a cross-modality Transformer as a strong foundation. O 2 -VG-Uni further provides universal oriented proposals using only an objectness prompt and supports efficient oriented object retrieval. Based on these proposals, O 2 -VG-VLM adopts multi-token prediction in an autoregressive vision-language model for efficient oriented box generation. In addition, we construct DIOR-R-RSVG, a new dataset for oriented object visual grounding containing triplets of images, referring expressions, and oriented bounding boxes. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed unified framework.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提议O 2-VG家族在遥感图像中进行面向物体的视觉定位. O 2-VG-Trans引入了跨模式变换器作为坚实的基础. O 2 - VG - Uni 进一步提供了仅使用对象提示的面向通用的建议,并支持高效面向对象的检索. 基于这些建议,O 2-VG-VLM在自动回转的视觉语言模型中采用多键预测,用于高效的导向箱生成. 此外,我们还构建了DIOR-R-RSVG,这是一个用于面向对象的视觉定位的新数据集,包含图像的三进制,引用表达式,以及面向边框. 对多种基准的广泛试验表明拟议统一框架的有效性。
